# ClickUp

> ClickUp is an all-in-one productivity platform where software, AI, and humans converge to maximize work efficiency through unified task management, collaboration, and intelligent automation.

ClickUp offers comprehensive work management solutions powered by ClickUp Brain AI, featuring Super Agents for task automation, unified team communication through Chat, document collaboration, and customizable workflows for teams across all departments. The platform serves organizations from small teams to enterprises with flexible pricing and deep integrations with tools like Slack, ChatGPT, Gemini, and Claude.

## AI & Automation Features

- [ClickUp Brain](https://clickup.com/brain): ClickUp Brain AI platform connecting projects, docs, and knowledge with universal AI capabilities.
- [ClickUp Brain MAX](https://clickup.com/brain/max): ClickUp Brain MAX premium AI assistant with universal search and advanced intelligence.
- [AI Super Agents](https://clickup.com/brain/agents): ClickUp Super Agents AI feature for task automation, delegation, and intelligent workflow execution.
- [AI Project Execution](https://clickup.com/ai-solutions/project-execution): ClickUp AI Project Execution with specialized agents for project delivery and management.
- [Automations & Workflow Builder](https://clickup.com/features/automations): ClickUp automation features for workflow optimization with AI-powered builder capabilities.
